name: hard_v3 hidden tests for the 50 coding questions (PRIVATE: never show the model)
how_to_grade: The model must end with FINAL_CODE: and one Python code block defining solve(data).
For each test, call solve(test["input"]) on a fresh copy of the input. Convert the result to JSON and compare with test["expected"]; it must match exactly (list order matters, true is not 1).
A coding question is correct only if ALL of its tests pass, the input is not modified, and the whole set finishes within 10 seconds of CPU time.
Run the code in an isolated sandbox (a container or a throwaway machine), never directly on your own computer: it is untrusted code.
